name: file
expr: model/map/ch_env/{map}_env.msb: MSB section chain at version 0x00989A6C, all records in EVENT_PARAM_ST
evidence: m4000_env.msb has 21 events: 17 type 100, 1 type 101, 2 type 102, 1 type 400. 0x827ffa80 applies each event by type, called twice per env (r5 flags 0xEC then 0x13); the type-400 (BGM) branch 0x82800128 only fires for mission envs (private/xenia/envlook_mission2.jsonl, probe env_bgm)

name: event
expr: u32 name, i32 id, u32 type, u32 index, u32 data; offsets relative to the record
evidence: Read by 0x827ffa80 (type at +8, data at +0x10). Types 100 light set, 101 scene parameters, 102 wind, 400 BGM; 103 and 500 are rare

name: light.slot
expr: data byte 1 * 32 + data byte 0
evidence: 0x82c2c400 copies a type-100 record into the light-set table at that slot (probe lightset_copy reads [r4+0]/[r4+1]). m4000: 0 ID00 AC, 1 ID01 map, 2 ID02 mountain, 3 ID03 water surface, 4 ID04 underground, 6 ID06 distant view, 10-18 SFX lights, 19 SFX rubble, 20 enemy base light

name: light.dir
expr: toward the light = (-cos p * sin y, sin p, -cos p * cos y), p / y = s16 degrees at +2/+4 (light 0) and +0x28/+0x2a (light 1)
evidence: 0x82c2bc48 uploads c3 / c4. m4000 ID01 (p 42, y 140) uploads (-0.4777, 0.6691, 0.5693) (private/xenia/envlook_mission2.jsonl, probe light_upload)

name: light.color
expr: c5 = rgb(+8)^2 * w(+8), c6 = rgb(+0x2c)^2 * w(+0x2c); c11 / c12 the same from +0x18 / +0x3c
evidence: 0x82c2bc48, gamma flag *(*(0x83a4e62c)+0x9ac) = 1 in game (probe light_upload values match rgb^2*w)

name: light.hemi
expr: A = conv(+0x70) sky, B = conv(+0x80) ground, conv = rgb^2 * w; c32..c34 rows = (axis * (A-B)/2, (A+B)/2) per channel, axis (0,1,0); ambient(N) = B + (A-B) * (1 + N.y) / 2
evidence: 0x82c2bc48 (probe light_upload); axis from the light block slot 12

name: light.extra
evidence: 0x82c2bc48; Flver_ColDif does not read c39 (water sets w = 6)

name: fog.block
expr: +0xa0 col0, +0xb0 range, +0xb4 start, +0xb8 unused (-50), +0xbc falloff, +0xc0 density, +0xc4 luma tint, +0xc8 rising byte, +0xcc height range, +0xd0 height base, +0xd4 col1
evidence: 0x82c2b428 copies them into the 0x40-byte fog block (+0 col0, +0x10 col1, +0x20 range, +0x24 height range, +0x28 falloff, +0x2c rising, +0x30 density, +0x34 luma tint, +0x38 start, +0x3c height base) (probe fog_upload)

name: fog.c13
expr: (col0.w * density, start, range > 0 ? 1/range : 0, ±1/max(falloff, 0.1)), sign + when rising

name: fog.c14
expr: (col1.w * density, height base, (height range > 0 ? 1/height range : 0) * c13.w, camera world y)
evidence: 0x82c2b4d8; f1 = [r4+0x34] at 0x82cb1e48 (fog manager +0x68) from the per-view updater 0x82c09f58: 36.8 at the AC test camera, -28.8 for the mirrored water-reflection view

name: fog.c9_c10
expr: c9 = (col0.rgb^2, luma tint), c10 = (col1.rgb^2, luma tint)
evidence: 0x82c2b4d8 converts each colour with 0x82bd2268 (rgb^2 when the gamma flag is set, w kept) and vsel's the luma tint into w (mask 0x82122d50)

name: shader
expr: map pieces: Flver_ColDif (Map_Diffuse); sky: NoLightNoFog (Map_Sky.mtd); water: Water.spx
evidence: shader/flver_shader.bnd Normal/Flver_ColDif.fpo; material/m4000_mtd.bnd

name: sky
expr: object o9705 (m4000_map.msb part at the origin), one Map_Sky material `sky` with g_DiffuseTexture o9705sky_ht (model/obj/o9705/o9705.tpf.dcx, 2048x512 BC3, v 0 = zenith, v 1 = horizon); colour (tex.rgb * tex.a)^2. Every map's sky is one of six such domes o9700-o9705 (a full hemisphere, radius ~822 m, horizon to zenith); there is no cubemap skybox
evidence: The m4000 dome texture matches the 360 AC test shot (private/xenia/shots/ac_test_start.png) once placed as in sky.place; its top rows are blue at alpha 67 (a cloud break at the zenith)

name: sky.place
expr: world = translate(camera x, part y, camera z) * scale(scene.sky_scale), rotation from the part (0 on every dome part)
evidence: Sky pass (probe private/xenia/sky_obj.txt, 0x82c0a160 after the sky pass begin 0x827f3d38): VC_aObjMatrix (c12-c14 of Normal/Flver_Sky.vpo) = diag(100) at (-303.65, 0, 655.5) with the camera at (-303.65, 37.6, 655.5) (c7 VC_MatrixCamera). Part y is 0 on every dome but m9100's (-69.8), so y = part y is the reading; m4000 water height is 3

name: sky.depth
expr: projection depth row zeroed, viewport MinZ = 1 (0 when *(*(0x83a4e62c)+0x9c4) is set): every sky pixel lands on the far plane, never far-clipped
evidence: 0x827f3d38 calls 0x827d1d90 (projection at device +0x4a0 times the 0x8201a140 / 0x8211f670 / 0x8202cfa0 / 0x8211f590 rows) and sets the viewport MinZ from 0x82000fc4; probe private/xenia/sky_view.txt reads the result (1.358, 2.414, depth column 0). The Map_Sky material hook 0x82bd5278 (class 0x820f20a4, picked by 0x82bd5518 on the MTD name) does the same but did not fire in the AC test

name: scene.sky_scale
expr: type-101 first sub-block +0x1c, used when > 0 (default 1)
evidence: 0x827ffa80 type-101 branch copies it to runtime +0x28, the debug entry 天球スケール (0x8208cb7c, menu 0x827ff6d0). 100 on every env but m3710 (5); the sky pass object matrix scale reads 100 on m4000 (sky.place)

name: ps.albedo
expr: c0.rgb * (tex.rgb * tex.a * c16.rgb * vcol.rgb)^2
evidence: Flver_ColDif.fpo instructions 19-37 (c16 FC_HTTextureRenge_0)

name: ps.light
expr: ambient(N) * ao + sat(N.c3) * c5 + sat(N.c4) * c6, ao = lerp(1, SSAO, c136.x)
evidence: Flver_ColDif.fpo 17-38; N normalized by rsq

name: ps.fog
expr: d = |(cam - pos).xz|; dfog = sat(c13.x * (1 - 2^(-(d - c13.y) * c13.z))); hfog = sat(c14.x * sat(c14.z * (pos.y - c14.y)))
evidence: Flver_ColDif.fpo 6, 14-40 (pos.y = c14.w - view.y)

name: ps.fog_color
expr: luma = dot(col * c19.rgb, (0.29891, 0.58661, 0.11448)); col = lerp(col, c9.rgb * (1 + c9.w (luma - 1)), dfog); col = lerp(col, c10.rgb * (1 + c10.w (luma - 1)), hfog)
evidence: Flver_ColDif.fpo 40-48; luma weights are the shader literal c255

name: ps.out
evidence: c31 = draw context +0x210, set by 0x82c09e48 from (1,1,1,1) * 0.5 masked + (0,0,0,1) (0x82122bb0, 0x82122c00); probe draw_setup reads 0.5 in the mission

name: draw.sets
expr: draw info +8 / +0xc light ids, +0x10 / +0x14 fog ids, +0x18 / +0x1c blend weights
evidence: 0x82bd65e0 builds it; 0x82c0a160 -> 0x82cb2db8 (light) / 0x82cb1ca0 (fog) select. AC test mission: set 1 on 1348 of 1500 sampled draws, 2 on 74 (mountains m9002/4/6/8/16/18, private/xenia/envlook_inst.jsonl), 0 on 62 (AC), 3 on 9 (water), 19 on 7 (rubble); blend weights always 0. Which field of the model or part holds the id is open: the MSB part sub-struct word (+0x4c -> +4) is 1 on all 550 m4000_map.msb parts

name: scene.clear
expr: type-101 data -> first sub-block bytes 0..3
evidence: m4000: (37, 50, 49); far +4 = 15000. 0x827ffa80 stores rgb / 255 at runtime +0 / +4 / +8 (debug entry 背景色), +4 at +0x24 (描画距離 draw distance), +8 at +0x14 (水面の高さ water height), +0x18 at +0x18 (明るさ brightness), +0x20 at +0x1c (レーダー表示領域 radar area, default when <= 0), +0x5c at +0x10 (SFX ground height)

name: tonemap
expr: type-101 sub-block 2: +0 mode, +4.. parameters
evidence: m4000: mode 1, 0.5, 1.1, 0.6, 10. ToneMap_DivideToneMapPS (shader/filter_shader.bnd) = c33.x * x/(1+x) with x = col * adapted-luminance scale. Mode mapping and the luminance chain are open; the runtime shows col / c31 untonemapped
